<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F4F0FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hero" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9B0"/>
      <stop offset="46%" stop-color="#D3FFFA"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFC4FA"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="chair" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="24" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">9:41</text>
    <rect x="326" y="14" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="331" y="11" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="336" y="8" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>
    <path d="M347 18 L352 12 L357 18" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="365" y="9" width="19" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="11" width="14" height="8" rx="2" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>
  </g>

  <!-- small onboarding mark -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="32" cy="62" r="15" fill="#200E32"/>
    <polygon points="25,63 32,55 39,63 36,63 36,70 28,70 28,63" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="56" y="68" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">hub</text>
  </g>

  <!-- hero illustration -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="235" r="130" fill="#200E32" opacity=".08"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="228" r="130" fill="url(#hero)"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="115" cy="145" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".55"/>
  <circle cx="286" cy="165" r="11" fill="#FFDD72"/>
  <circle cx="292" cy="286" r="20" fill="#A5F59C" opacity=".8"/>
  <polygon points="93,286 111,262 129,286" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".75"/>
  <circle cx="111" cy="258" r="6" fill="#FF968E"/>

  <!-- framed wall art -->
  <g>
    <rect x="157" y="126" width="76" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
    <rect x="164" y="133" width="62" height="42" rx="4" fill="#FBA3FF" opacity=".6"/>
    <polygon points="168,168 183,147 194,160 204,145 222,168" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="143" r="5" fill="#FFDD72"/>
  </g>

  <!-- floor -->
  <path d="M83 310 Q194 280 307 310 L307 323 Q194 303 83 323 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".75"/>
  <!-- plant -->
  <g>
    <rect x="264" y="260" width="25" height="32" rx="5" fill="#FF968E"/>
    <path d="M276 260 C266 240 259 231 249 225 C261 224 275 233 278 248 C282 234 292 228 301 228 C294 243 287 254 278 263" fill="#97DAA4"/>
    <line x1="276" y1="260" x2="276" y2="238" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <!-- sofa -->
  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="235" width="119" height="55" rx="14" fill="#200E32" opacity=".12"/>
    <rect x="105" y="224" width="119" height="61" rx="14" fill="url(#chair)"/>
    <rect x="113" y="210" width="103" height="42" rx="13" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <rect x="123" y="218" width="38" height="27" rx="8" fill="#C393FF"/>
    <rect x="166" y="218" width="40" height="27" rx="8" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <rect x="96" y="238" width="15" height="48" rx="7" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <rect x="219" y="238" width="15" height="48" rx="7" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <rect x="120" y="281" width="9" height="19" rx="4" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="204" y="281" width="9" height="19" rx="4" fill="#200E32"/>
  </g>
  <!-- coffee table -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="174" cy="316" rx="60" ry="11" fill="#200E32" opacity=".1"/>
    <rect x="130" y="299" width="88" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <line x1="143" y1="309" x2="137" y2="329" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="309" x2="211" y2="329" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="294" r="8" fill="#FF968E"/>
  </g>
  <!-- lamp -->
  <g>
    <line x1="89" y1="174" x2="89" y2="267" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="3"/>
    <polygon points="68,177 110,177 102,201 76,201" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <circle cx="89" cy="170" r="5" fill="#434343"/>
    <path d="M74 201 Q89 207 104 201" fill="none" stroke="#FF968E" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- copy -->
  <text x="195" y="416" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Make space for</text>
  <text x="195" y="451" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">what matters</text>
  <text x="195" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Find furniture you love and bring your</text>
  <text x="195" y="507" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">space to life, one piece at a time.</text>

  <!-- pagination -->
  <g>
    <rect x="157" y="548" width="24" height="7" rx="4" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="188" y="548" width="7" height="7" rx="4" fill="#DADADA"/>
    <rect x="202" y="548" width="7" height="7" rx="4" fill="#DADADA"/>
    <rect x="216" y="548" width="7" height="7" rx="4" fill="#DADADA"/>
  </g>

  <!-- next button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="145" y="594" width="100" height="56" rx="28" fill="#200E32"/>
    <text x="181" y="629" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    <polyline points="213,617 221,622 213,627" fill="none" stroke="#A5F59C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- skip -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#5E6272">Skip</text>
    <line x1="177" y1="696" x2="213" y2="696" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="12" y="735" width="366" height="1" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,767 53,758 63,767 60,767 60,778 46,778 46,767" fill="#200E32"/>
      <text x="53" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="766" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="136" y1="772" x2="142" y2="778" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="130" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- saved -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="195,756 207,756 207,779 201,775 195,779" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="201" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- chat -->
    <g>
      <rect x="258" y="758" width="22" height="16" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="263,774 263,780 269,774" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="269" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="336" cy="763" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="336" cy="777" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="336" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="163" y="824" width="64" height="5" rx="3" fill="#200E32"/>
  </g>
</svg>
